_comment: The schema owner — dd-migrate-dev and dd-migrate-prod. It is a TASK, not a service: it runs
`prisma migrate deploy`, exits, and is never long-lived.
Migrations do not belong in the API's boot path. Two tasks starting together would race to
alter the same tables, and a failed migration would become a crash loop instead of a failed
deploy. _deploy.yml runs this to completion and refuses to touch a service until it exits 0.
It uses the MIGRATOR image, not the API image: `prisma` (the CLI) and `tsx` are dev
dependencies, and the runtime image installs production dependencies only. Same Dockerfile,
Two variables, one of them the database. The smallest surface in the system that can alter
the schema is the right size for it.
